_note: Youth Strategic Forum, Dubai 2026 — event rundown. Days 0 and 1 sourced from the client's Official Rundown PDF (YSF Dubai 2026 - Rundown.pdf, shared 2026-09-23). Day 2 detailed schedule not yet released by the client; Day 3 is check-out logistics.

days.label: September 22, 2026
days.title: Arrival & Networking
days.description: Delegates arrive and check into the hotel, gather for a welcome reception in the lobby, and set sail for a gala dinner cruise along Dubai's iconic skyline.

items.title: Hotel Check-in
items.description: Official check-in and settling into the forum hotel.

items.title: Welcome Reception
items.description: An introductory informal gathering for attendees to meet, mingle, and network in the hotel lobby before leaving for the Gala Dinner. This session establishes an open and welcoming environment, allowing participants to familiarise themselves with fellow delegates in a semi-formal setting. This marks the beginning of an intellectual journey where your unique perspectives will shape new paradigms for our shared economic future.

items.title: Gala Dinner — Dubai Cruise
items.description: An elegant evening cruise bringing delegates together for a gala dinner against the backdrop of Dubai's iconic skyline. The evening combines fine dining, cultural exchange, networking, and a memorable celebration of the YSF international community.

days.label: September 23, 2026
days.title: Main Event
days.description: A full day at the Mohammed Bin Rashid Library: opening orientation, a policy lab on sustainable futures, a debate on growth and sustainability, and sessions on energy diplomacy and cultural influence.

items.title: Breakfast at Hotel
items.description: Breakfast is served at the hotel between 07:00 and 09:00 ahead of departure.

items.title: Departure from Hotel
items.description: Delegates depart the hotel together for the Mohammed Bin Rashid Library.

items.title: Arrive at Mohammed Bin Rashid Library
items.description: Arrival and registration at the forum venue.

items.title: Guided Visit to the Mohammed Bin Rashid Library & Exhibition
items.description: A guided visit to the Mohammed Bin Rashid Library, Dubai's landmark cultural and knowledge institution and the official venue of YSF Dubai 2026. Delegates will explore its collections, architecture, and cultural spaces while engaging with Dubai's vision for knowledge, learning, and innovation.

items.title: Opening Session: Vision, Strategy & the YSF Experience
items.description: An opening orientation introducing the vision, objectives, and key themes of YSF Dubai 2026. The session will set the context for the Forum and prepare delegates for four days of international exchange, dialogue, and collaboration.

items.title: Policy Lab: Designing Practical Solutions for a Sustainable Future
items.description: An interactive workshop exploring how smart cities can move from ambition to implementation. Delegates will develop and test practical responses to real-world challenges while considering the relationship between environmental responsibility, social value, economic viability, and policy innovation.

items.title: Lunch Break
items.description: Lunch is served for delegates at the venue.

items.title: Debate Session — Can Economic Growth and Sustainability Truly Coexist?
items.description: A structured debate challenging delegates to examine the tensions and possibilities between economic growth, environmental responsibility, and social development. Delegates will take opposing positions, engage with competing arguments, and consider whether sustainability requires fundamentally rethinking how economies measure progress and prosperity.

items.title: Energy, Climate Policy & the Future of Multilateral Cooperation
items.description: A discussion examining the evolving relationship between energy policy, climate commitments, and international cooperation. Delegates will explore how domestic priorities, energy security, and shifting global dynamics influence the future of climate diplomacy and multilateral action.

items.title: Culture, Creativity & Global Influence
items.description: An exploration of how art, culture, aesthetics, and creative expression shape influence in international affairs. The session will examine the relationship between culture and strategy and consider how young people can approach global challenges not only as policy thinkers, but also as creative practitioners.

items.title: Conclusion & Reflection Session
items.description: A closing reflection to bring together the day's threads and mark the end of Day 1.

days.label: September 24, 2026
days.title: Day 2
days.description: Detailed schedule to be shared by the organisers.

days.label: September 25, 2026
days.title: Departure
days.description: A final breakfast together before delegates check out of the FORM Hotel Al Jaddaf and depart Dubai.

items.title: Final Breakfast
items.description: A last breakfast together before delegates go their separate ways.

items.title: Hotel Check-out
items.description: Delegates settle any accounts and check out of the forum hotel.

items.title: Delegate Departures
items.description: Onward travel as delegates depart Dubai.
